color.note: Fifteen palette colours: your seven brand colours (carbon, navy, cobalt, accent, periwinkle, lavender, mist) and eight support colours derived from them for the app's grounds, lines and secondary text. Semantic tokens are aliases of the palette; the brand-* tokens are for the dark brand surfaces only; the reserved families (the four states, Fictional patient, Frozen demo) keep their own values.

tokens.name: carbon
tokens.usage: Main palette · one of your seven. The dark: Karma's ink. Used by `ink` (all primary text), through it `action` (the main button), and by `brand-ground` (the dark landing section and title slides). Text on `white`, `page`, `mist`, `ice` and `highlight`: 18.6, 17.2, 15.0, 16.5 and 14.2:1.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Main palette · one of your seven. The deep blue. Used by `action-hover` (white lettering 13.4:1), `link-hover` (13.4:1 on `white`) and `brand-glow`, the soft light behind the dots on dark brand surfaces.

tokens.name: cobalt
tokens.usage: Main palette · one of your seven. The royal blue for text. Used by `link` (links and NCT IDs): 8.2:1 on `white`, 7.6:1 on `page`, 6.6:1 on `mist`, 7.3:1 on `ice`. And by `brand-dot-1`, the smallest dots of the light.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Main palette · one of your seven. The bright blue, Karma's signature. Used by `focus-ring`, `selected-line` and `evidence-line` (4.8:1 on `white`, 4.5:1 on `page`, 3.9:1 on `mist`; rings and edges need 3:1), the pulled line on the cover, and `brand-dot-2`. Too light for small text on `page` and `mist`, so links use `cobalt`. Never a fill behind text, never a state.

tokens.name: periwinkle
tokens.usage: Main palette · one of your seven. The light blue of the dot light (`brand-dot-3`). Brand surfaces only: never text, never a state, never in the app's work screens.

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: Main palette · one of your seven. The palest of your blues. Used by `evidence-mark`, laid over the quote on the page image with `mix-blend-multiply` (`ink` reads 9.9:1 on it), and by `brand-dot-4`.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Main palette · one of your seven. The light grey. Used by `surface-sunken` (table heads, hovered rows, loading skeletons, source chips at rest) and, on dark brand surfaces, by `brand-ink`, `brand-action` and `brand-dot-5` (15.0:1 against `carbon`).

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Main palette · support. Cards and everything raised above the page ground. Used by `surface` (cards, header, footer, the evidence panel, inputs) and `action-ink` (the lettering of the main button). A background, not a text colour.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Main palette · support, a neutral step between `white` and `mist`. The paper: the page ground behind every card. It is also the token you use for that ground, `bg-page`. If you change it, keep the text colours readable on it.

tokens.name: fog
tokens.usage: Main palette · support, a neutral grey between `mist` and `cloud`. Hairlines. Used by `line` (card borders, table dividers) and `disabled-fill`.

tokens.name: cloud
tokens.usage: Main palette · support. The stronger rule that must survive a projector. Used by `line-strong`.

tokens.name: pewter
tokens.usage: Main palette · support. The mid grey. Used by `control` (edges of inputs, secondary buttons, chips, the drop zone), `ink-muted` and `disabled-ink`. As text, on `white` and `page` only: 5.1:1 and 4.7:1. As an edge it needs 3:1.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Main palette · support. Secondary text. Used by `ink-secondary` and `control-hover`. Text on `white`, `page`, `mist` and `ice`: 8.9, 8.2, 7.2 and 7.9:1.

tokens.name: ice
tokens.usage: Main palette · support: `lavender` mixed into white (20%). Used by `selected-tint`: the selected chip, tab or row.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Main palette · support: `lavender` mixed into white (45%). Used by `evidence-tint`, the highlighter behind quoted words (`ink` on it: 14.2:1).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, header, footer, the evidence panel, inputs, table rows. Alias of `white`. Text on it: `ink` 18.6:1, `ink-secondary` 8.9:1, `ink-muted` 5.1:1, `link` 8.2:1. `bg-surface`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header band, hovered rows, loading skeletons, the source chip at rest. Alias of `mist`. Text on it: `ink` (15.0:1), `ink-secondary` (7.2:1) and `link` (6.6:1). Keep `ink-muted` off it (4.1:1). `bg-surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders, header and footer rules, table row dividers. Decorative, never the only edge of a control. Alias of `fog`. `border-line`, `divide-line`.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Hairlines that must survive a projector: the sticky matrix header rule, the source chip border, section rules on the case card. Alias of `cloud`. `border-line-strong`.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Edges of things you operate: inputs, secondary buttons, filter chips, the drop zone, inactive source tabs. 5.1:1 on `surface`, 4.7:1 on `page` (needs 3:1). Alias of `pewter`. `border-control`.

tokens.name: control-hover
tokens.usage: Control edge on hover. Alias of `graphite`. `hover:border-control-hover`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: values, criterion text, quotes, headings. 18.6:1 on `surface`; at least 14:1 on every light ground and tint in the app (9.9:1 on the lavender `evidence-mark`). Alias of `carbon`. `text-ink`.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Labels, metadata, column headers, the tagline, the footer. 8.9:1 on `surface`, 8.2:1 on `page`, 7.2:1 on `surface-sunken`. Alias of `graphite`. `text-ink-secondary`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Optional metadata only (timestamps, file sizes), on `surface` (5.1:1) or `page` (4.7:1). Never on `surface-sunken` (4.1:1) and never on a projector screen. Alias of `pewter`. `text-ink-muted`.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, the one dark element per view. Alias of `ink`. `bg-action`.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button fill on hover: the brand navy, so the hover shows Karma's colour. White lettering 13.4:1. Alias of `navy`. `hover:bg-action-hover`.

tokens.name: action-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `action` (18.6:1) and `action-hover` (13.4:1). Alias of `white`. `text-action-ink`.

tokens.name: disabled-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of a disabled primary button. Alias of `fog`. `bg-disabled-fill`.

tokens.name: disabled-ink
tokens.usage: Text of any disabled control. Disabled controls are exempt from the 4.5:1 rule, and this one still reads 3.7:1 against `disabled-fill`. Alias of `pewter`. `text-disabled-ink`.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links, NCT IDs, "Open the criterion matrix →". 8.2:1 on `surface`, 6.6:1 on `surface-sunken`. Only 2.3:1 against `ink`, so inside a sentence a link is always underlined; elsewhere its place, the mono ID or the arrow marks it. Alias of `cobalt`. `text-link`.

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: Link on hover, always with an underline. 13.4:1 on `surface`. Alias of `navy`. `hover:text-link-hover`.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px outline, 2px off the element. 4.8:1 on `surface`, 4.5:1 on `page`, 3.9:1 on `surface-sunken` (a focus ring needs 3:1). Alias of `accent`. `outline-focus-ring`.

tokens.name: selected-tint
tokens.usage: Background of the selected thing: the open source chip, the active source tab, the row whose evidence panel is open. Alias of `ice`. Text on it: `ink` 16.5:1, `ink-secondary` 7.9:1, `link` 7.3:1. `bg-selected-tint`.

tokens.name: selected-line
tokens.usage: Edge of the selected thing (2px), 4.8:1 on `surface`. Alias of `accent`. `border-selected-line`.

tokens.name: evidence-tint
tokens.usage: Highlighter behind the quoted words in the evidence panel. `ink` on it is 14.2:1. Never put a link on it. Alias of `highlight`. `bg-evidence-tint`.

tokens.name: evidence-mark
tokens.usage: The highlighter laid over the quote in the page image. Always with `mix-blend-multiply`, so the scan's own ink stays visible through it; stronger than `evidence-tint` so it still shows on a grey scan. Alias of `lavender`. `fill-evidence-mark`, `bg-evidence-mark`.

tokens.name: evidence-line
tokens.usage: 2px outline around the highlighted quote on the page image, 4.8:1 on `surface`. Alias of `accent`. `stroke-evidence-line`, `outline-evidence-line`.

tokens.name: brand-ground
tokens.usage: Brand surfaces only: the dark ground of the landing page's main section and of title slides. The app's work screens stay light. Alias of `carbon`. `bg-brand-ground`.

tokens.name: brand-glow
tokens.usage: Brand surfaces only: a soft radial glow behind the dot light, used at about 70% opacity on `brand-ground`. Decorative. Alias of `navy`.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `brand-ground`: 15.0:1. Keep it off the dot light itself. Alias of `mist`. `text-brand-ink`.

tokens.name: brand-action
tokens.usage: The one button on a brand surface ("Try the demo"): a `mist` fill with `brand-action-ink` lettering. Alias of `mist`. `bg-brand-action`.

tokens.name: brand-action-ink
tokens.usage: Lettering on `brand-action`: 15.0:1. Alias of `carbon`. `text-brand-action-ink`.

tokens.name: brand-dot-1
tokens.usage: The light made of dots, outer edge: the smallest dots (1.1px radius at 10px spacing). Five dot grids of the same spacing are stacked, each with a bigger, paler dot and a smaller visible area, so the dot you see grows and pales toward the core. Decorative (`aria-hidden`), never behind text. Alias of `cobalt`.

tokens.name: brand-dot-2
tokens.usage: The light made of dots, second ring (1.7px dots). Alias of `accent`.

tokens.name: brand-dot-3
tokens.usage: The light made of dots, middle (2.4px dots). Alias of `periwinkle`.

tokens.name: brand-dot-4
tokens.usage: The light made of dots, near the core (3.0px dots). Alias of `lavender`.

tokens.name: brand-dot-5
tokens.usage: The light made of dots, the core (3.5px dots). Alias of `mist`.

tokens.name: fictional-ink
tokens.usage: Text of the Fictional patient badge, 8.2:1 on `fictional-tint`. Violet is used for nothing else. `text-fictional-ink`. Tailwind default: violet-800.

tokens.name: fictional-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of the Fictional patient badge. `bg-fictional-tint`. Tailwind default: violet-50.

tokens.name: fictional-line
tokens.usage: Border of the Fictional patient badge. `border-fictional-line`. Tailwind default: violet-300.

tokens.name: frozen-ink
tokens.usage: Text of the Frozen demo badge, 9.45:1 on `frozen-tint`. `text-frozen-ink`. Tailwind default: slate-700.

tokens.name: frozen-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of the Frozen demo badge. `bg-frozen-tint`. Tailwind default: slate-100.

tokens.name: frozen-line
tokens.usage: Border of the Frozen demo badge (one step darker than today's slate-300 so the grey badge still shows on a projector). `border-frozen-line`. Tailwind default: slate-400.

tokens.name: state-met-solid
tokens.usage: Icon of **met** (filled circle). Darker and bluer than today's emerald-600 so it separates from `state-not-met-solid` in greyscale and for red-green colour blindness. 7.6:1 on `surface`. `bg-state-met-solid`, `fill-state-met-solid`. Tailwind default: teal-800.

tokens.name: state-met-glyph
tokens.usage: The check inside the met icon, 7.6:1 on `state-met-solid`. `stroke-state-met-glyph`. Tailwind default: white.

tokens.name: state-met-ink
tokens.usage: The word "met" and its count, 8.8:1 on `state-met-tint`, 9.5:1 on `surface`. `text-state-met-ink`. Tailwind default: teal-900.

tokens.name: state-met-tint
tokens.usage: Pill fill for met: a quiet grey-green, so settled rows stay calm. `bg-state-met-tint`.

tokens.name: state-met-line
tokens.usage: Pill border for met. `border-state-met-line`.

tokens.name: state-not-met-solid
tokens.usage: Icon of **not met** (filled square). A touch warmer than today's red-600 (`#DC2626`) so that, for protanopia, it stays apart from `state-met-solid`. 4.8:1 on `surface`. `bg-state-not-met-solid`, `fill-state-not-met-solid`.

tokens.name: state-not-met-glyph
tokens.usage: The cross inside the not met icon, 4.8:1 on `state-not-met-solid`. `stroke-state-not-met-glyph`. Tailwind default: white.

tokens.name: state-not-met-ink
tokens.usage: The words "not met" and the count, 9.2:1 on `state-not-met-tint` (one step darker than today's red-800 so it holds on a projector). `text-state-not-met-ink`. Tailwind default: red-900.

tokens.name: state-not-met-tint
tokens.usage: Pill fill for not met. `bg-state-not-met-tint`. Tailwind default: red-50.

tokens.name: state-not-met-line
tokens.usage: Pill border for not met. `border-state-not-met-line`. Tailwind default: red-200.

tokens.name: state-not-found-solid
tokens.usage: The dashed ring and dash of **not found**, and the "not in the documents" marker on the case card. 4.8:1 on `surface`. `stroke-state-not-found-solid`. Tailwind default: slate-500.

tokens.name: state-not-found-ink
tokens.usage: The words "not found" and "not in the documents", 10.4:1 on `surface`. `text-state-not-found-ink`. Tailwind default: slate-700.

tokens.name: state-not-found-tint
tokens.usage: Pill fill for not found: hollow, because nothing was in the documents. `bg-state-not-found-tint`. Tailwind default: white.

tokens.name: state-not-found-line
tokens.usage: Pill border for not found, always dashed (`border-dashed`). `border-state-not-found-line`. Tailwind default: slate-500.

tokens.name: state-clinician-solid
tokens.usage: Icon of **needs a clinician** (filled diamond, the flowchart shape for a decision). Lighter than every other state so it stands apart in greyscale. `fill-state-clinician-solid`. Tailwind default: amber-400.

tokens.name: state-clinician-glyph
tokens.usage: The "!" inside the diamond: dark on amber, 9.0:1 (white was 2.1:1). `fill-state-clinician-glyph`. Tailwind default: amber-950.

tokens.name: state-clinician-edge
tokens.usage: 1px outline of the diamond, so the light amber icon still has a 7:1 edge on white and on a washed-out projector. `stroke-state-clinician-edge`. Tailwind default: amber-800.

tokens.name: state-clinician-ink
tokens.usage: The words "needs a clinician" and the count, 8.8:1 on `state-clinician-tint`. `text-state-clinician-ink`. Tailwind default: amber-900.

tokens.name: state-clinician-tint
tokens.usage: Pill fill for needs a clinician. `bg-state-clinician-tint`. Tailwind default: amber-50.

tokens.name: state-clinician-line
tokens.usage: Pill border for needs a clinician. `border-state-clinician-line`. Tailwind default: amber-200.

families.sans: Geologica, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: "Overpass Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Geologica, sharp: the sharpness axis is fixed at 100 inside the font file, so every weight is the sharp cut with no extra CSS. Self-hosted as one variable file (weights 100–900, Latin and Cyrillic, Bulgarian forms under lang="bg"). 14px is the floor.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: The landing page's main headline at desktop width, in `brand-ink` on `brand-ground`. On smaller screens scale it with clamp(44px, 6.6vw, 96px). Brand surfaces only. `text-hero`.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Big in-app headlines and title slides. `text-display`.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page titles: the patient on the case card, the trial on the criterion matrix. Same size as today. `text-title`.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card and panel titles, the criterion in the evidence panel, empty-state headlines. `text-heading`.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default for everything else: field values, criterion text, table cells, buttons (with `font-semibold`). Same size as today. `text-body`.

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: Verbatim evidence quotes only, one step larger than body so evidence is the loudest text on screen. Keep the document's own language and punctuation. `text-quote`.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: The floor: pills, chips, badges, metadata, helper text, the footer. Nothing in Karma is smaller than 14px. `text-small`.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels and badge words, always set uppercase (`text-label uppercase`). Replaces today's 12px labels.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: Overpass Mono, self-hosted as one variable file (weights 300–700, Latin and Cyrillic). For NCT IDs and compact source chip numbers only.

styles.name: trial-id
styles.usage: NCT IDs and compact chip numbers ("02 · p. 1"), in Overpass Mono with tabular figures (`font-mono text-small font-medium`). 14px, the floor.

spacing.note: Tailwind's default 4px scale, unchanged: `space-4` is `p-4` is 16px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a source chip's icon and its text; between stacked chips. `gap-1`, `p-1`.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Gap between a state icon and its word inside a pill; left padding of pills. `gap-1.5`, `pl-1.5`.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between pills in a row, between chips, between a label and its input. `gap-2`.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Right padding of pills and badges. `pr-2.5`, `px-2.5`.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input and small-button padding; vertical padding of table rows. `px-3`, `py-3`.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button padding; cell padding; gap between field rows. `px-4`, `gap-4`.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page side gutters (as today) and card padding. `px-5`, `p-5`.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between case-card sections; evidence panel padding. `gap-6`, `p-6`.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page regions (case card and trial list). `gap-8`.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Top padding of a page below the header. `pt-10`.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding; landing sections. `py-12`.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Header height and title-slide margins. `h-16`.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Badges and source chips (as today). `rounded-md`.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, source tabs. `rounded-lg`.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Drop zone, the page-image frame, the expanded source list. `rounded-xl`.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Cards (as today). `rounded-2xl`.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: State pills, count pills, filter chips (as today). `rounded-full`.

shadow.note: Flat. Three elevations, all tinted with `carbon`.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards at rest, if anything. The system is flat: a white card on `page` with a `line` border is enough. `shadow-card`.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Things that float over content: the expanded source list, the stuck matrix header. `shadow-raised`.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: The evidence side panel, pinned to the right edge. `shadow-panel`.

size.note: Fixed sizes and the layout grid.

tokens.name: size-icon-sm
tokens.usage: State icons in pills, chips and the legend. `size-4`.

tokens.name: size-icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons, the drop zone and the evidence panel header. `size-5`.

tokens.name: size-chip
tokens.usage: Source chip height: the WCAG 2.2 minimum target. `h-6`.

tokens.name: size-pill
tokens.usage: State pill, count pill and badge height. `h-7`.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and filter chips. `h-8`.

tokens.name: size-control-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs. `h-10`.

tokens.name: size-header
tokens.usage: App header height (as today). `h-16`.

tokens.name: size-gutter
tokens.usage: Page side gutters (as today). `px-5`.

tokens.name: size-content-max
tokens.usage: Content column (as today). With the 20px gutters it stays inside a 1920px projector image at 125% browser zoom (1536 CSS px). `max-w-content`.

tokens.name: size-panel
tokens.usage: Evidence side panel width. `w-panel`.

tokens.name: size-text-floor
tokens.usage: The smallest text allowed anywhere, on screen and on the projector. `text-small`, `text-label`.
